summary.text: Terry Spahr is a Democratic member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives from Grafton 12 who has held the seat since December 4, 2024 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A film and video producer, he earned undergraduate and graduate degrees from the University of Pennsylvania.

paragraphs.text: Terry Spahr earned a bachelor's degree and a graduate degree from the University of Pennsylvania.
His career experience includes working as a producer in television and film.
